daily.today_energy: Your vibe is all about quiet rebellion today, Aquarius. There's magic in doing your own thing without needing validation. Trust the weird thoughts—they're actually your intuition speaking.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your authentic energy. Whether you're single or taken, vulnerability hits different today. Let people see the real you, not the polished version.
daily.career: Your unconventional ideas are your superpower rn. Don't dim that light to fit in. The momentum you build today through staying true to your vision will compound soon.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for slowness today. A walk, some tea, or just sitting with your thoughts will do wonders. Rest isn't laziness—it's strategy.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to trust your gut instincts, Aquarius. Mercury's movement brings clarity to situations that felt foggy before. You're stepping into a phase where your unconventional thinking becomes your superpower—lean into it.
weekly.love: Connection deepens when you show up as your authentic self. If you've been holding back vulnerability, this week invites you to share what's real. Singles might feel unexpected sparks; coupled folks are reminded why they fell in love.
weekly.career: Your ideas are landing differently right now—people are actually listening. This is the moment to pitch that project or speak up in meetings. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed, even if it doesn't fit the mold.
weekly.health: Your nervous system needs grounding this week. Try activities that anchor you—walks, creative hobbies, or time offline. Energy flows best when you balance your active mind with moments of stillness and presence.
